title: Workspace Spec
description: WorkspaceSpec is the kind-specific body of a `kind: Workspace` manifest.

description.description: Description explains the workspace's purpose (AI readability).

display_name.description: Human-readable workspace name — shown in admin surfaces

owner_user_id.description: Optional user ID seeded as workspace owner — empty = no seeded owner (first admin via setup wizard)

settings.description: Free-form workspace metadata persisted to the registry row (json) — structured platform settings belong to kind: Config

slug.description: URL-facing workspace slug — defaults to metadata.name; kebab-case, unique across the deployment
